system.name: CoTaEval
system.one_liner: An evaluation framework for copyright takedown methods in language models: similarity to blocklisted text, retained factual utility, and overhead.

content.variant_note: a Harry Potter question and takedown scenario on the left; five section-numbered grey boxes on the right act as the paper outline
content.argues: A good takedown stops the model from regurgitating blocklisted text yet keeps facts and stays cheap; the rest of the figure outlines causes, methods, benchmark and results.
content.subject: A regurgitation scenario fixed by a copyright takedown, beside a section-numbered outline of causes, desired behaviour, benchmark, methods and results.

lessons.what_to_learn: Pair a one-glance scenario (pink bad answer, labelled arrow, green good answer, three ticks) with an outline of boxes headed by the paper's section numbers, so one figure states the problem and previews the paper.
lessons.suits: evaluation or position papers whose contribution is a framework plus findings, which must show a failure case and a roadmap in one figure.

evidence: Effective takedown methods should prevent models from generating text matching the blocklisted content (low similarity)
(3) ensure the efficiency of the model (low overhead) (see Figure 1)

summary: CoTaEval is an evaluation framework for copyright takedown methods in language models: a takedown should stop the model from regurgitating blocklisted text while keeping uncopyrightable facts and staying efficient. Figure 1 pairs a framed scenario on the left (the question Who is Lily Potter? gets a pink bubble copied from the book, flagged Regurgitation! with a siren; after Copyright Takedown a shielded robot gives a green factual answer under three ticks) with five grey boxes on the right headed by purple section numbers: causes, desired behaviour, the benchmark, takedown methods, and results that end in sad faces with red crosses.
summary_zh: CoTaEval 评估语言模型的版权下架方法：既要避免复述受保护文本，又要保留事实并控制开销。图 1 左侧用 Lily Potter 问答演示复述与下架后的回答，右侧五个灰色章节框依次给出成因、期望、基准、方法与结果。
notes: Prior labels listed scope-overview (benchmark-dashboard); the small CoTaEval box is a three-line list, not a dashboard, so that kind is dropped. A 5 pt text item in the digest (Low similarity High utility Low Overhead) is the three ticked captions at the lower left. The results unit is read as negative takeaways from the sad faces and the abstract (no tested method excels across all metrics); the figure does not say which result each arrow stands for.
